material: ZrSiX (X = S, Se, Te), P4/nmm; GGA Wannier models without spin-orbit coupling released by Zhang and Yazyev (2025), Materials Cloud record tyan3-q3j67
orbitals: per cell: Zr1 d(5), Zr2 d(5), Si1 s p(4), Si2 s p(4), X1 p(3), X2 p(3); no spin index (24 bands)

bands.limits: k_frac: 1-500 points; velocities true returns dE/dk (eV Angstrom) per band

fermi_slice.limits: k = origin + i/(nu-1) u + j/(nv-1) v (fractional); 2 <= nu, nv <= 121; returns bands 10-15

electron_count.limits: mesh in [40, 80, 120, 160] (Gamma-centred N x N x N/2); 1-200 chemical potentials within mu_range_eV; temperature 0-300 K

orbit.limits: 1-8 start points; any field direction (Cartesian); arc length 0.1-40 1/Angstrom

magnetotransport.limits: 1-4 chemical potentials within mu_range_eV; temperature 10-40 K; bands from the list below; field from field_menu

field_planes.bc: B = (0, sin a, cos a): from c (a = 0) towards b (a = 90)
field_planes.ac: B = (sin a, 0, cos a): from c (a = 0) towards a (a = 90)
field_planes.ab: B = (cos a, sin a, 0): in the ab plane, a from the a axis

magnetotransport.method: Chambers formula, one relaxation time for all bands; orbits of every start point of the Gamma-centred N x N x N/2 mesh traced on the start point's constant-energy surface (the 40 and 80 meshes are subsets of the 160 mesh); results scale as rho = rho_tau / tau.
